subject: Order still not here after rescheduling
body: Hi, I'm writing about my order of running shoes from your Shenzhen Nanshan store. The first delivery attempt didn't work out, so I rescheduled through the link in the message and picked a new time. That was supposed to be two days ago, and nothing has arrived since. I've checked with the building front desk too, in case it was left there, but they don't have anything for me. At this point I just want to know where the shoes actually are and when I can expect them, because I've been waiting around for a delivery that never showed up. Can you look into it and let me know?
